method: Per O*NET task: AI-exposed = Anthropic Economic Index task penetration > 0 (observed AI use); robotics-exposed = Anthropic robot exposure tier E1-E3; safe = rated in either source and neither; no_data = in neither source. Work activities, skills and abilities are linked only through official O*NET 31.0 files: tasks_to_dwas, gwas_to_iwas_to_dwas, essential/transferable_skills_to_work_activities, abilities_to_work_activities; each element's ai_share / robotics_share / safe_share is the share of its linked task time in each group (a task's time is split evenly across its DWAs). Technology is occupation-level (O*NET has no task link).
